evidence: GaAs growth was carried out using trimethylgallium (TMG) as the Ga source and AsH3 as the As source. These were alternately fed into the growth chamber for 1 and 2 s, respectively, with a hydrogen purge time between each gas supply. Hydrogen carrier gas was fed continuously into the chamber at a flow rate of 2500 cc/min, and the total pressure was 1.2X10’Pa. Dimethylaluminumhydride (DMAH) was used as the Al source for the AlAs ALE growth, which has previously been achieved using the DMAH/AsH3 system.
